frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/layout/TenantSectionEditor.tsx:59-84 — PropInput displays string prop values raw (no quotes) then commit() calls JSON.parse(val) first. A string value like "true", "123", "null" or "[]" is displayed as-is, and any onBlur (even with no user edit) parses and stores it as the coerced boolean/number/null/array in override.sections[type].props, silently corrupting the override payload sent by handleSave → useSaveTenantLayoutOverride.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/layout/DashboardCustomizePage.tsx:58-69 — comment says 'Only clear dirty if the override hasn't changed since we sent' but the check `JSON.stringify(localOverride) === json` compares two snapshots of the same closure-captured localOverride — tautologically true. Concurrent edits made during the in-flight mutateAsync (the TenantSectionEditor is not gated by mutation.isPending) are not detected; isDirty is cleared on success and the user may navigate away thinking the newest keystrokes were saved. A ref mirroring localOverride is needed for a real 'changed since sent' check.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/dashboard/hooks/useActionQueue.ts:240-297 — queryFn returns generateMockData() after a setTimeout(300) with TODO 'Replace with actual API call when backend is ready' (line 243); executeAction mutation does the same and resolves { success: true } without hitting any endpoint. This hook backs ActionQueue, which is a required section in dashboardRegistry (LayoutRenderer → registry.tsx:22-26) on ManagerDashboardPage and is used directly by ResidentDashboardPage — so production users see fabricated action items and approve/reject/dismiss clicks are silent no-ops.
